- Improved documentation: Updated and streamlined SKILL.md for clarity, security, and user instructions.
- Added a roadmap (references/roadmap.md) for clearer project direction.
- Added a Windows setup script (scripts/setup.bat) for easier environment setup.

- Clarified dependency setup process: Skill will not auto-run setup scripts or pip installs during ordinary search; missing dependencies require user approval before any installation.
- Updated description to highlight knowledge-base management as well as retrieval.
- Improved security and privacy notice wording, emphasizing no silent installation and local storage boundaries.
- Minor language and structural refinements to feature highlights for clarity.
- No code logic or runtime changes; documentation only.

**Major skill architecture overhaul for structured, honest knowledge retrieval with strict anti-hallucination principles.**

- Introduces a three-phase workflow: environment check, target file search, and structured answering/description update.
- Enforces explicit anti-hallucination rules: never fill gaps, guess, or use pre-trained knowledge in place of search results.
- Establishes clear entry points for knowledge base setup and user information requests.
- Supports lazy loading, on-demand index rebuilding, and dynamic strategy adjustment (e.g., for large files).
- Adds clear instructions for handling environment changes, file index updates, and user-directed maintenance commands.
- Provides decision checklists and degradation rules to ensure accuracy and transparency at every step.
